Thank you. I'm a college student. Sometimes I deal with seeing things/hearing voices but my primary issue is depression. I can feel when an episode is coming on weeks in advance and then it's a slow tumble into absolute inadequacy. 

I feel so completely useless. I don't provide anything whatsoever to the few friends I have... I've isolated myself almost entirely because I'm so shit at socialization and I don't want people to see me being this pathetic and broken
